packs.name: Neon Riot
packs.description: Bright-but-menacing rage synth chords: add9 and sus stacks, open fifths and major lifts at 150 to 170.

packs.name: Static Crown
packs.description: Harder rage loops with dorian lifts, #9 dominants and fast two-beat changes.

packs.name: Velvet Coffin
packs.description: Ominous vamp-style minor progressions with chromatic bass descents and tritone moves.

packs.name: Sugar Glitch
packs.description: Glossy hyperpop-rap chords: major 7ths, add9s and lydian colour at 155 to 180.

packs.name: Cowbell Cathedral
packs.description: Memphis and drift phonk in phrygian and harmonic minor, heavy on diminished chords and b9 dominants.

progressions.title: Laser Halo
progressions.description: F#m(add9) to Dadd9 and an open Asus2, then E over G# lifts straight back into the tonic. Pulse it under a fast hat roll and let the open fifths do the shouting.

progressions.title: Cherry Overdrive
progressions.description: A bright add9 tonic that turns sour on the Fmaj7#11, then a suspended E that cracks open into E7b9. Stab it hard and leave space for the 808.

progressions.title: Chrome Teeth
progressions.description: Eight bars that keep E and B ringing on top while the bass walks under them, then a suspended G# that drops into a full dominant. The major lift on bar three is the hook.

progressions.title: Bloodmoon Sprint
progressions.description: The same four upper notes sit over G and then Eb, so the colour flips from minor to lydian without moving a finger. Ends on a gritty D7#9 turnaround.

progressions.title: Venom Glitter
progressions.description: Close cluster voicings that barely move: Em(add9), Cmaj9, D over F#, then a suspended B that resolves to B7. Pulse it on a bell or pluck.

progressions.title: Pixel Guillotine
progressions.description: A minor-key run that keeps F on top for six bars, opens the Gb into a #11 on the repeat and lands on a suspended F that bites as F7b9.

progressions.title: Sugarcoat Riot
progressions.description: Dm(add9) into a soft Bbmaj9, a bright F over A, then Gm9 and a dark A7b9 pickup. The relative-major bar is the lift before the sting.

progressions.title: Hazard Bloom
progressions.description: One cluster shape over B and then G turns minor into lydian, Em9 keeps the top steady, and F#7#9 snaps it back. Stab it with a detuned saw.

progressions.title: Acid Paradise
progressions.description: Eight bars in Eb minor that lean on the bVI and bIII for brightness, then a #11 on the second pass and a suspended Bb that resolves to a full dominant.

progressions.title: Red Static
progressions.description: Cm(add9) to Abmaj9 and Eb over Bb, then a major F over A: the dorian lift that makes rage chords feel triumphant instead of sad.

progressions.title: Riot Glare
progressions.description: Long six-beat chords with two-beat kicks into the next one. The Neapolitan Gbmaj7 in bar seven darkens it right before C7b9 throws it back to the top.

progressions.title: Gutter Comet
progressions.description: G#m11 into Emaj9 and Badd9 with B held on top, then F# over A# walks the bass back up. Bright, wide and loopable for days.

progressions.title: Overclock Prayer
progressions.description: Tight inner voices over a moving bass: F#m9, Dmaj9, Bm11 and a sus-to-dominant C#. The second half swaps in an open Esus2 and a nasty C#7#9.

progressions.title: Diamond Fever
progressions.description: Em9 to a lydian C, Am9 dropping the register, then B7sus4 into B7b9. The b9 on top is the menace.

progressions.title: Hollow Crown
progressions.description: C#m(add9), Amaj7 and F#m9 keep C# and E in the middle while the bass drops, then G# suspends and resolves. Low and wide for a slower rage bounce.

progressions.title: Sonic Barbwire
progressions.description: Bm9 and Gmaj9 share three notes, D over F# brightens it, Em11 hangs. The second pass goes lydian, opens up on Asus2 and ends on a full bar of F#7#9.

progressions.title: Hex Sprinter
progressions.description: Two-beat changes for a fast, restless loop: the bass moves every half bar while the top barely does. Ebadd9 lifts before the C7#9 snaps it shut.

progressions.title: Afterburn Hymn
progressions.description: Am11 and Fmaj9 float, then a major D over F# gives the dorian lift and E7sus4 to E7 pulls it home. Big and anthemic at 170.

progressions.title: Crypt Neon
progressions.description: A chromatic bass descent from C through B and Bb to Ab under a held Eb-G shape, then Fm9, the Neapolitan Db and a slow G7b9 resolve. Arp it on a cold synth.

progressions.title: Tritone Mass
progressions.description: Em9 jumps a tritone to Bbmaj7#11, which keeps E in the voicing, then Cmaj7 and B7b9. The tritone leap is the whole mood.

progressions.title: Velvet Descent
progressions.description: A line-cliche bass falling A, G#, G, F#, F, E under a steady A minor shape, then Dm9 and a sharp E7#9 to restart. Roll it slowly on strings or a pad.

progressions.title: Gothic Pulse
progressions.description: Tonic to the phrygian G, then a tritone drop to C before C#7b9 drags it back. Pulse it with a sidechained saw.

progressions.title: Black Sedan
progressions.description: Gm9, Ebmaj7, Cm11 and a dark D7b9, then the second half swaps in a tritone-away Dbmaj7#11 and ends on F#dim7, a leading-tone chord that never quite resolves.

progressions.title: Sigil Hour
progressions.description: Bbm11 and a lydian Gb, then the bass jumps a tritone to Eø7 before F7b9 resolves home. Long held pads, no drums needed to feel the dread.

progressions.title: Coffin Glow
progressions.description: A fast chromatic bass descent D, C#, C, B, Bb, A under a frozen F-A shape, two beats per chord. The A7b9 at the end is pure vamp tension.

progressions.title: Wraith Engine
progressions.description: C#m11 to Amaj9, then the Neapolitan D and a harmonic-minor G#7b9. The back half adds a minor-major tonic and a tritone G before the #9 dominant.

progressions.title: Hearse Arp
progressions.description: Only one voice moves (F, E, Eb) while the bass walks down with it, then it settles on a lydian Db. Arp it on a glassy synth.

progressions.title: Obsidian Choir
progressions.description: Ebm9, Cbmaj7 and Abm11 into Bb7b9, then a tritone-away Amaj7#11 that holds the same notes respelled. Lush and ominous on a choir pad.

progressions.title: Phantom Dial
progressions.description: Bm(add9) drops a tritone to Fmaj7#11 with B kept as the #11, Gmaj9 eases off and F#7b9 lands the menace. Pulse it in eighths.

progressions.title: Ash Cathedral
progressions.description: G#m9, a lydian E and C#m9, then D7#11 a tritone away whose G# keeps a thread to the tonic. Roll it on an organ.

progressions.title: Grave Shift
progressions.description: Eight bars of bass falling by half steps from E to C under a held G and F#, then a phrygian F before B7b9. Built for a slow-burn vamp.

progressions.title: Spectral Lane
progressions.description: Gm11 to the phrygian Ab, then C#dim7 a tritone from the root and D7b9 to resolve. Dark, slow and wide.

progressions.title: Bubblegum Orbit
progressions.description: Dmaj9, Bm(add9), Gmaj9 and A6, with F# always in the voicing. Sweet, bright and made to pulse under pitched-up vocals.

progressions.title: Glitter Mainframe
progressions.description: Major-seven sparkle with a lydian A, C#m9 and Badd9, then G#m7 and a floating B9sus4 that never fully resolves. Arp it on a bell.

progressions.title: Candy Firewall
progressions.description: Amaj9 to a lydian D with G# kept on the bottom of the voicing, F#m11 and E over G# to walk back up. Bounce it on a pluck.

progressions.title: Cloud Lag
progressions.description: Two-beat changes at 180 through Cmaj9, Em9 with a lydian F#, a #11 on F and a secondary D7 over F#. Busy, bright and glitchy.

progressions.title: Hologram Crush
progressions.description: Fmaj9 and a lydian Bb, Dm9 and C over E stepping the bass back up, then Am7, Bbmaj9 and a C9sus4 that hangs. Arp it fast and let it shimmer.

progressions.title: Pastel Overload
progressions.description: Bbmaj9, a lydian Eb, Gm9, then F over A climbing back to the root. Push every chord early for that rushing hyperpop feel.

progressions.title: Sparkle Shard
progressions.description: Gmaj9 into a lydian C whose voicing carries straight into Em(add9), then Dsus2 and D over F# to climb home. Light and bouncy.

progressions.title: Starlight Inbox
progressions.description: Abmaj9, Fm9 and a lydian Db into a suspended Eb, then Cm7 and Dbmaj9 rising to a clean Ebadd9. Wide-eyed and glossy.

progressions.title: Wifi Angel
progressions.description: Bmaj9 and a lydian E, G#m9 and a floating F#9sus4. Fast eighth-note pulse on a bell patch sells it.

progressions.title: Sugar Rush Protocol
progressions.description: Six-beat chords with two-beat pickups: Dbmaj9, a lydian Gb, a suspended Ab, then Ebm9 and Ab9 back to the top.

progressions.title: Rainbow Lag
progressions.description: F#maj9 to a lydian B, D#m9 and C#add9, with E# ringing through every chord. Arp it on a pluck and pitch it up.

progressions.title: Lilac Server
progressions.description: Ebmaj9, a lydian Ab, Cm11, and a suspended Bb that resolves to Bbadd9. Push it early for a breathless top-line bed.

progressions.title: Memphis Fog
progressions.description: C#m(add9) slides up a half step to the phrygian D, then a harmonic-minor G#7b9 and a minor-major tonic. Pure Memphis smoke under a cowbell.

progressions.title: Tape Hiss Prayer
progressions.description: Fm9, a phrygian Gb, Edim7 and C7b9: every chord leans on the half step. Arp it on a lo-fi bell.

progressions.title: Cobra Lowrider
progressions.description: Am(add9), the phrygian Bb, G#dim7 and E7b9, then Dm9, a #11 Bb and a gritty E7#9. Bounce it slow and low.

progressions.title: Smoke Hallway
progressions.description: Dm11 to the phrygian Eb, then C#dim7 and A7b9 with Bb held on top through three chords. Pulse it with a distorted 808.

progressions.title: Haunted Cassette
progressions.description: Gm(add9), a phrygian Ab with the D kept as #11, Cm9 and a harmonic-minor D7b9. Slow, held and tape-warped.

progressions.title: Crown Vic Choir
progressions.description: Bm9 to the phrygian C, A#dim7 and F#7b9, then Em9, a lydian C and F#7#9. Roll it on a choir patch for that cathedral Memphis sound.

progressions.title: Ghost Cowbell
progressions.description: Em(add9) up a half step to Fmaj7, then D#dim7 and B7b9 sharing the C. Stab it between cowbell hits.

progressions.title: Purple Slab
progressions.description: F#m9 to a lydian G, then E#dim7 and C#7b9 sharing B, D and G#. Bounce it under a chopped vocal.

progressions.title: Handbrake Neon
progressions.description: G#m(add9) up a half step to Amaj7, Emaj7, and D#7b9 with its b9 on E. Pulse it fast with a cowbell lead for drift phonk.

progressions.title: Sideways Siren
progressions.description: Cm9, the phrygian Db, Bdim7 and G7b9, then a held cluster over C and Ab, Fm9 and G7#9. Stab it hard for drift phonk.

progressions.title: Burnout Lane
progressions.description: Ebm(add9) slides up a half step to Emaj7, then Ddim7 and Bb7b9 share Ab, B and F. Pulse it under a cowbell melody.

progressions.title: Midnight Touge
progressions.description: Two-beat harmonic-minor changes at 160: Am9, Fmaj7, Dm9 and E7b9, then a minor-major tonic, #11 F, G#dim7 and E7#9. Arp it fast.

progressions.title: Clutch Kick Ritual
progressions.description: Bbm9 to the phrygian Cb, then Adim7 and F7b9 with Gb hanging on top. Bounce it on a bell for drift phonk.

progressions.title: Gravel Chapel Rims
progressions.description: A line-cliche bass falling D, C#, C, Bb under a held E-F cluster, then Gm9, the phrygian Eb, C#dim7 and A7b9. Roll it on a dusty piano.

progressions.title: Slide Lights
progressions.description: Fm(add9) to a lydian Gb a half step up, then Edim7 and C7b9 sharing Db, G and Bb. Fast eighth pulse with a cowbell on top.

progressions.title: Drift Requiem
progressions.description: Gm9, a phrygian Ab, Ebmaj7 and F#dim7, then a minor-major tonic, Cm11, Abmaj9 and D7#9. Held and wide, slower drift for the outro.
